samples: This module handles simple semantic versions made of three non-negative numeric parts: major, minor, and patch, without pre-release or build metadata. It can parse text into a version with clear errors, print versions back to text, compare them in normal version order, find the latest version in a list, and check whether one version satisfies another by requiring the same major version and no downgrade. Use it if you need lightweight SemVer-style handling for plain versions like 1.4.2.

This module parses, formats, compares, and selects semantic versions made of exactly three non-negative numeric parts: major, minor, and patch, without pre-release or build metadata. It reports clear parse errors for the wrong number of parts or non-numeric/negative parts, can check whether a candidate version satisfies a required one by requiring the same major version and no older ordering, and can return the latest version from a list. Use it if you need simple SemVer-style handling for versions like 1.4.2, but not full SemVer features such as pre-release labels or build metadata.

This module handles simple semantic versions with exactly three nonnegative numeric parts: major, minor, and patch, without pre-release or build metadata. It can parse version text, format versions back to text, compare versions, choose the latest from a list, and report clear parse errors for the wrong number of parts or nonnumeric parts. It also provides a compatibility check where a candidate version satisfies a required version only if it has the same major version and is not older.

This module provides a small semantic-version utility for versions made of three non-negative numeric parts: major, minor, and patch, without pre-release or build metadata. It can parse text into a version with clear errors for wrong part counts or non-numeric parts, print versions back to text, compare them in major-minor-patch order, find the latest version, and check whether one version satisfies another by having the same major version and being no older.

This module provides a small semantic-version utility for versions made of exactly three non-negative numeric parts: major, minor, and patch, without pre-release or build metadata. It can parse and print versions, compare them in major/minor/patch order, pick the latest version from a list, and check whether one version satisfies another by having the same major version and being at least as new. Parsing reports clear errors when the input has the wrong number of parts or contains a non-numeric or negative part.
